title: PAPI: Exploiting Dynamic Parallelism in Large Language Model Decoding with a Processing-In-Memory-Enabled Computing System
technique: PIM-enabled heterogeneous system with dynamic kernel scheduling for decoding

optimized_metrics.evidence: we aim to accelerate LLM decoding

headline_claim.text: PAPI achieves 1.8× and 11.1× speedups over a state-of-the-art heterogeneous LLM accelerator (i.e., GPU and PIM) and a state-of-the-art PIM-only LLM accelerator, respectively
